zh-CN.title: 手绘小屋真正住进了朋友
items: 夜航友间与午后花房取消整幅漂移和随机飘落效果
动物会探头、呼吸、轻跳和浇水，植物也会沿着根部自然摆动

en.title: The illustrated rooms come alive
items: Rooms at Night and Afternoon Conservatory no longer drift as a whole or use floating particles
Animals now peek, breathe, hop, and water plants while foliage sways naturally from its roots
